preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 50,000.
The number of vertices n in each test case must be between 1 and 500,000.
The number of edges must be exactly n - 1 for each test case.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n and 1 <= u <= n for v, u in edges)
preconditions.description: All vertices in the edges must be within the range from 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: len(colors) == n and all(c in 'WN' for c in colors)
preconditions.description: The length of the colors string must be n and each character must be either 'W' or 'N'.

postconditions.description: The output must be one of 'White', 'Draw', or 'Black' for each test case.
If the output is 'White', there must be at least one white vertex in the initial configuration.
If the output is 'Draw', all vertices must be initially uncolored.
